title: Mentorship pulse and onboard ops sync — platform eng
body:
Meeting: Mentorship pulse + Onboard ops sync — Platform Eng
Date: 2025-11-04 10:00 PT (30m)
Attendees: Marcus Chen (note), Renee Alvarez, Samir Kapoor, Joey Martinez, Priya Nair, Grace Liu (joined briefly)
Context: weekly check focused on new-grad cohort ramp, mentor load balancing, and recurring onboarding friction points reported in the last 2 weeks. This doc captures raw notes, action items, and follow-ups — intentionally informal.

Agenda
- Quick headcount & hiring updates
- Onboarding painpoints (access, infra, docs)
- Mentorship pairing and load distribution
- Early ramp metrics and quality signals
- Action items / owners

Notes
1) Headcount & hiring
- New grad cohort: 6 started (Platform Eng: 3), another 4 offers accepted for Jan start (2 platform slots).
- Open reqs: PLAT-SWE-6 (infra), PLAT-SRE-2. · Recruiter update (Renee): pipeline improving but we still need a stronger referral push for infra SWE L4-L5.
- Interview velocity: avg time from screen->onsite = 14 days (target 10). Bottleneck = scheduling with senior ICs.

2) Onboarding ops friction (recent reports)
- Laptop provisioning: 3 incidents where Macs were delayed by 5+ business days. Root cause: vendor PO cadence + new shipping SLA.
- Cloud access: two new hires lacked sandbox project permissions for first 48 hours; culprit = onboarding playbook step 6 not auto-triggering in Okta flow.
- Local dev: docs for running the local inference stack are ~60% complete; missing kv-cache dev notes and example small-model weights. New grads spent 2-3 days waiting for a mentor to unblock.
- Remote dev environment (devbox) instability: base image update last week caused python deps mismatch for ml-e2e tests.

3) Mentorship pairing and load
- Current mentor:mentee ratio in Platform Eng = 1:2 for active mentors (6 mentors, 12 mentees). Mentor capacity stress flagged by mentors — average weekly mentoring time ~6 hours (target max 4).
- Suggested changes: rotate 1 mentor off heavy project duties for first 6 weeks of cohort; formalize weekly 1:1 mentor office hours (30m drop-in).
- Peer-pairing: trial pairing matrix proposed — cross-team pairing for 2 hours/week to reduce single-mentor blockers.

4) Early ramp metrics & quality signals
- Median time to first meaningful PR (mergable) for cohort = 18 days (target 10-14).
- First-week checklist completion rate = 78% (missing items: infra sandbox, local-run tutorial, pager access).
- Code review turnaround for new grads: median 2.1 days; aim <48 hours.

5) Hiring debriefs (quick notes from last 2 loops)
- Strong candidates lost due to slow recruiter throughput and unclear interview expectations for infra role.
- Interview debriefs often show inconsistent rubric usage across panel — need a quick calibration doc for infra interviews (Samir to draft).

6) Quick wins identified
- Automate Okta provisioning step for "sandbox" role via recruiter webhook to eliminate 48h delays (Priya to prototype authn webhook).
- Create a small 'local inference devkit' bundle (docker image + minimal weights + README) for faster first-PR paths — Joey to open GH issue and draft image.
- Mentor hours: temporarily grant mentors up to 0.1 FTE (project time reallocation) for cohort onboarding weeks 1-6 — ask leads for temporary schedule adjustments.

Action items (owner — due)
- Priya: prototype Okta provisioning webhook and demo to ops by 2025-11-11
- Joey: open infra-bootstraps issue with devkit proposal + initial dockerfile by 2025-11-07 (PR link in linked artifacts once ready)
- Samir: draft a 1-page infra interview calibration checklist + sample questions; circulate for feedback by 2025-11-10
- Renee: run referral drive with growth channel and send a tracker to hiring managers by 2025-11-14
- Marcus: schedule mentor office hours calendar template and share with mentors by 2025-11-06
- Grace: follow up with procurement on Mac vendor SLA and escalate if no response by 2025-11-12

Risks / Blockers
- If mentor overtime continues, mentor burnout risk increases and ramping will slow — mitigation: hire 1 IC L4 dedicated to infra mentorship (raise req).
- Procurement lead time for laptops may push new hires to shadow-only ramp — we need loaner hardware policy for first 2 weeks.

Decisions made
- Approve temporary 0.1 FTE for mentors weeks 1-6 for current cohort (Leads to update weekly plans).
- Approve building the local inference devkit as priority infra-bootstraps task.

Parking lot / unresolved
- Evaluate whether internship/coop hires should be paired differently vs full-time grads — need data on conversion & ramp time (ask people ops for last 2 years).
- Long-term: evaluate mentoring rotation policy across all Eng subteams to distribute load — larger discussion in Nov 25 all-hands.

Notes to self (informal)
- Collect 3 mentor anecdotes for weekly all-hands highlight; keep it short and human.
- Re-check first-week checklist steps in Confluence and mark auto-triggered steps (these are the ones that break most often).

Follow-ups scheduled
- 2025-11-11: demo Priya's Okta webhook prototype (15m sync after weekly standup)
- 2025-11-07: infra-bootstraps PR review (Joey)
- 2025-11-12: procurement update meeting with Grace and procurement lead

Appendix
- Snapshot headcount: Platform Eng total = 42 (ICs), mentors flagged = 6, active mentees = 12 in current cohort.
- Useful links: See linked_artifacts above for playbook + open PR reference.

End of notes.
